| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Low gain** `gammaLow` | 0.5 | 0 to 1 | The gain gamma_L for the lowest frequencies, which carry the lighting. |
| **High gain** `gammaHigh` | 2 | 1 to 4 | The gain gamma_H for the high frequencies, which carry the reflectance and detail. |
| **Sharpness** `sharpness` | 1 | 0.1 to 5 | The constant c that sets how fast the gain rises from gamma_L to gamma_H. |
| **Cutoff** `cutoff` | 0.05 | 0.005 to 0.5 cycles/px | The frequency D_0 around which the gain rises, in cycles per pixel. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
